gddGap: The GDD sets no level count, tiers or level list. This is an extra proposed level (order 6, after the five in levels.json) that introduces the GDD-named Rust units in escalation: Iron Line cordon, then Watchers, then Breakers. Wave numbers and the 150 s limit are placeholders in the Tier 0 shape. Uses the proposed expansion enemies from rust-gdd-units.json, so it depends on owner approval of those.
name: The Iron Line Push
theme: Stewpot Gardens, where the Rust have strung a line of barriers between the planters and the food stalls; steam still rises from the stew pots behind it.
intro: The Iron Line is holding the garden gate. Faceless helmets, cheap plating. Zed's neighbours are watching from the stalls. Push the line back, then the Watchers and Breakers behind it.
outro: The line gives way and the stew pots are steaming again. A neighbour waves a ladle from the stall. The garden is the neighbourhood's once more.
notes: Bosses per the-story-campaign#1 (miniBoss/mainBoss are enemy ids, not wave entries). Main boss cut: Overseer Dr. Maren Holt was removed from the game (2026-11-03), so this level has no main boss. Owner decision: the mini-boss arrives as a mini wave, a beatable pressure wave led by the mini-boss, deliberately not too hard and not a hard gate. Owner decision: the main boss gets its own separate fight phase after the waves (own arena phase, phases per the GDD). Owner decision (2026-11-03): two waves added. Wave 5 is a mixed wave of four different enemy types (Iron Line Cordon, Watcher, Breaker, grunt) with elites scattered. Owner decision (2026-11-05): the level is 5 waves and wave 5 is the boss wave: Dr. Holt's Experiment, Subject 88, leads a crew of 6 (Iron Line Cordon and Watcher in random order, mixRandom). The old 10-enemy mixed wave 5 and the old wave 6 are gone. restartTimerOnBoss resets the clock when the boss wave starts (set on every level with a boss). Subject 88 art is a placeholder for the owner's test. Holt keeps her separate phase after the waves.

miniBoss.note: beatable pressure wave led by the mini-boss

gddGap: Owner request (2026-11-03): Level 7 grows from 3 solo waves to 5 mixed waves with no boss. Waves 1-4 mix Grunts, Watchers, Breakers and Copper Fangs, with a big health pickup after every wave; wave 5 is a surge of all four types (12 enemies, maxAlive 6, no boss). Commander Atlas (canon Level 7 mini-boss) is deliberately not placed in this level by owner decision; his data in mini-bosses.json is unchanged. The GDD gives no wave list. Only one restPickup per wave is supported, and none after the last wave, so the finale relies on the heal from wave 4.
name: Copper Fang at the Courts
theme: The forest-green basketball courts, hoops bent but standing, with a Rust command post set up at centre court and kids' chalk drawings still on the asphalt.
intro: Varr's favourite is guarding centre court: a Copper Fang with a shield and a hook. Block, dodge, parry. Give the kids their court back.
outro: The shield cracks and the Fang is pushed back off the court. Somewhere a ball bounces, then another. Zed breathes out. Game on.
notes: Owner request 2026-11-03: 5 waves, mixed enemies, final wave is a surge of 4 types (grunt, rust-watcher, rust-breaker, rust-copper-fang), no boss, large health drops (50/60/70/80). Atlas is not placed here by owner decision. Open for src owner: enemyKinds.js only knows grunt and rust-watcher, so breaker and copper-fang mix entries fall back to plain grunt stats/skin until KINDS is extended. Finale (2026-11-05): after wave 5 the screen drops 3 full-health items and 5 throwable bats (U/N/pad B to throw).

gddGap: The GDD gives Overseer Halden Varr, "The Architect of Rust" (GDD wording, owner-confirmed) the Main Boss slot in the Corporate Tower command chamber, but defines no level list or tiers. This proposes the end-level boss encounter (order 8) as the last level of the Rust push, against Varr. Varr's own summons (Command Override, Drone Command) are behaviour in rust-gdd-units.json, not wave data, so waves here are a single-unit ladder (counts cannot shrink; one enemy type per wave). The district id is the closest existing lore district (Songwindow Heights, surveillance tower and screens); the Corporate Tower arena itself is not yet a district, a GDD gap. The named Overseers Kade Voss (Neon Market) and Rhea Calder (Factory floor) have no level yet. Owner decision (2026-11-05): all six waves removed; the level is the Varr final fight alone, one wave with 3 random crew.
name: The Overseer's Tower
theme: Songwindow Heights, where a surveillance tower and propaganda screens loom over the windows that used to play music; murals half-painted over in grey.
intro: Varr runs the whole city from this tower, with squads, drones and shields at his call. Fight through, reach the command chamber and break the order. Let the music back in.
outro: The screens flicker out and Varr gives up the tower. A window opens, then another, and music drifts down over the Heights. The first mural stroke goes back up.
notes: Owner decision (2026-11-05): Level 8 is the final boss fight only. One wave: Halden Varr as leader (hpMult 8, gate) with 3 random crew (mixRandom) after his first move. Two phases: Authority (100-30% HP) and Rust Protocol (below 30%, with additional moves and a different state). Varr has no boss class in src/ yet (VarrBoss pending). Earlier 6-wave ladder removed.

mainBoss.note: Halden Varr leads the only wave with 3 random crew; phase 2 Rust Protocol at 30 percent HP with extra moves
